blocks.text: CEBU, PHILIPPINES — SMX Convention Center Seaside Cebu proudly announces its opening as the official host venue for two major co-located regional trade gatherings from November 26 to 28, 2026: the 15th Anniversary Edition of PHILCONSTRUCT Visayas and the returning Visayas Business Connect Expo 2026. Brought together through the expert organization of Global-Link MP Events International, Inc. alongside its co-organizers including the Philippine Constructors Association (PCA) these landmark events mark a monumental occasion for Cebu’s MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions) landscape. As the newest flagship facility within the SMX Convention Center network under SM Hotels and Conventions Corp., SMX Seaside […]...
